response_raw:
Factory_Pipeline
agents:
	humans:
robots: Robot1, Robot2
locations: warehouse, surface_texturization_start, surface_texturization_end, laser_start, laser_end, loading_area
resources: raw_materials, texturized_materials, lasered_materials

Robot1:
	default moveTo surface_texturization_start
	1: pick raw_materials
	2: moveTo surface_texturization_end if possess(Robot1,raw_materials) else stop
	3: skip if not possess(Robot1,texturized_materials)
	4: moveTo laser_start
	5: moveTo laser_end
	6: skip if not possess(Robot1,lasered_materials)
	7: moveTo loading_area
	8: deposit lasered_materials

Robot2:
	default moveTo surface_texturization_start
	1: pick raw_materials
	2: moveTo surface_texturization_end if possess(Robot2,raw_materials) else stop
	3: skip if not possess(Robot2,texturized_materials)
	4: moveTo laser_start
	5: moveTo laser_end
	6: skip if not possess(Robot2,lasered_materials)
	7: moveTo loading_area
	8: deposit lasered_materials

success: time(100)
failure: dist(Robot1,Robot2) > 50 && !possess(Robot1,lasered_materials) || !possess(Robot2,lasered_materials)
